description: TY2026 mfj: the full credit cascade. Wages 100,000, spouse (lower) earned 30,000, 2 care-qualifying kids, $8,000 expenses. AGI 100,000 -> pct: 50 - ceil(85,000/2,000)=43 -> floor 35; no second phase-down (AGI <= 150k) -> 35%. Expenses min(8,000, 6,000 cap, EI, spouse 30,000) = 6,000 -> CDCC 2,100. TI 67,800 -> Tax Table mid 67,825 -> 2,480 + 12% x 43,025 = 7,643. CTC 2 x 2,200 = 4,400 (no phase-out) limited to 7,643 - 2,100 = 5,543 -> 4,400. After credits 7,643 - 2,100 - 4,400 = $1,143.00.
